controls.title: Understanding the organization and its context
controls.default_evidence: Documented internal and external issues (e.g. context analysis) relevant to the ISMS, with review date.

controls.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
controls.default_evidence: Register of interested parties and their requirements, including legal, regulatory and contractual ones.

controls.title: Determining the scope of the information security management system
controls.default_evidence: Approved ISMS scope statement covering boundaries, interfaces, locations and exclusions.

controls.title: Information security management system
controls.default_evidence: ISMS manual or equivalent showing the processes and how they interact.

controls.title: Leadership and commitment
controls.default_evidence: Evidence of management commitment: meeting minutes, resourcing decisions, policy sponsorship.

controls.title: Policy
controls.default_evidence: Approved information security policy, communicated to staff and relevant parties, with version history.

controls.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
controls.default_evidence: Documented ISMS roles and responsibilities, org chart, appointment records.

controls.title: Information security risk assessment
controls.default_evidence: Risk assessment methodology, risk criteria, and completed risk register with owners.

controls.title: Information security risk treatment
controls.default_evidence: Risk treatment plan, Statement of Applicability with justifications, risk owner approval of residual risk.

controls.title: Information security objectives and planning to achieve them
controls.default_evidence: Measurable objectives with owners, timelines and progress tracking.

controls.title: Planning of changes
controls.default_evidence: Records showing how changes to the ISMS were planned and assessed.

controls.title: Resources
controls.default_evidence: Budget, staffing and tooling records supporting the ISMS.

controls.title: Competence
controls.default_evidence: Competence requirements, training records, qualifications and skills matrix for ISMS roles.

controls.title: Awareness
controls.default_evidence: Awareness programme materials, attendance records and policy acknowledgements.

controls.title: Communication
controls.default_evidence: Communication plan covering what, when, with whom and how for the ISMS.

controls.title: Documented information
controls.default_evidence: Document control procedure, master document list, version and approval records.

controls.title: Operational planning and control
controls.default_evidence: Evidence planned processes are run and controlled, including outsourced processes.

controls.title: Information security risk assessment
controls.default_evidence: Risk assessment results from planned intervals or after significant changes.

controls.title: Information security risk treatment
controls.default_evidence: Implemented treatment plan records and updated risk treatment results.

controls.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
controls.default_evidence: Defined metrics, measurement results and analysis reports.

controls.title: Internal audit
controls.default_evidence: Audit programme, audit plans, reports, auditor independence records and follow-up.

controls.title: Management review
controls.default_evidence: Management review agenda, minutes, inputs, outputs and resulting decisions.

controls.title: Continual improvement
controls.default_evidence: Improvement log or register showing actions taken to improve the ISMS.

controls.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
controls.default_evidence: Nonconformity register, root cause analysis, corrective actions and effectiveness checks.

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.default_evidence: Approved information security policy set, review dates, publication and acknowledgement records.

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.default_evidence: Role descriptions, RACI matrix, assignment of security responsibilities.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.default_evidence: Conflicting duties matrix, access reviews showing separation, compensating controls where needed.

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.default_evidence: Evidence managers require staff to follow security policies, e.g. briefings, communications, reviews.

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.default_evidence: List of relevant authorities with contact details and escalation procedure.

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.default_evidence: Memberships or subscriptions to security forums, bulletins and industry groups.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.default_evidence: Threat intelligence sources, review records and examples of resulting actions.

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.default_evidence: Project methodology showing security requirements and risk checks; sample project records.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.default_evidence: Asset inventory with owners, classification and location, plus review evidence.

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.default_evidence: Acceptable use policy and staff acknowledgements.

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.default_evidence: Leaver checklist and records showing assets returned.

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.default_evidence: Classification scheme and examples of classified information.

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.default_evidence: Labelling procedure and sample labelled documents or systems.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.default_evidence: Transfer rules, secure channel configuration, transfer agreements.

controls.title: Access control
controls.default_evidence: Access control policy and evidence it is applied to systems.

controls.title: Identity management
controls.default_evidence: Joiner-mover-leaver process, identity lifecycle records, unique ID evidence.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.default_evidence: Credential policy, MFA enforcement settings, secure credential issuance.

controls.title: Access rights
controls.default_evidence: Access provisioning records, periodic access review results, revocation evidence.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.default_evidence: Supplier security policy, supplier risk assessments, supplier register.

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.default_evidence: Contract clauses or security addenda with suppliers.

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.default_evidence: Supply chain requirements, due diligence records, sub-supplier flow-down clauses.

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.default_evidence: Supplier performance reviews, assurance reports (e.g. SOC 2, ISO certificates), change notifications.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.default_evidence: Cloud security policy, provider assessments, shared responsibility mapping, exit plans.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.default_evidence: Incident response plan, roles, contact lists, test or exercise records.

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.default_evidence: Event triage criteria and sample records of event classification.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.default_evidence: Sample incident records showing response, containment and closure.

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.default_evidence: Post-incident reviews and resulting improvement actions.

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.default_evidence: Forensic evidence handling procedure and chain-of-custody records.

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.default_evidence: Continuity plans showing security is maintained during disruption.

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.default_evidence: Business impact analysis, recovery objectives, DR and continuity test reports.

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.default_evidence: Legal and contractual requirements register with owners and review dates.

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.default_evidence: IP and software licensing policy, licence inventory, compliance checks.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.default_evidence: Records retention schedule and protection measures for critical records.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.default_evidence: Privacy policy, records of processing, DPIAs, privacy roles.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.default_evidence: Independent or external audit reports and management responses.

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
controls.default_evidence: Compliance check results, technical compliance reviews, follow-ups.

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.default_evidence: Operating procedures for key systems, version controlled and accessible.

controls.title: Screening
controls.default_evidence: Background check policy and completed checks for a sample of staff.

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.default_evidence: Contracts with security responsibility clauses for a sample of staff.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.default_evidence: Training plan, content, completion records, phishing exercise results.

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.default_evidence: Documented disciplinary process covering security breaches.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.default_evidence: Exit procedure and reminders of continuing confidentiality duties.

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.default_evidence: NDA templates and signed samples for staff and third parties.

controls.title: Remote working
controls.default_evidence: Remote working policy, VPN and endpoint controls, approved arrangements.

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.default_evidence: Reporting channel, staff guidance, sample reported events.

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.default_evidence: Site plans, perimeter definitions and barriers such as walls, locks and access points.

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.default_evidence: Badge and visitor logs, access lists, entry control records.

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.default_evidence: Photos or inspection records of locked rooms and restricted areas.

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.default_evidence: CCTV or alarm coverage, monitoring records, retention settings.

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.default_evidence: Fire, flood and power protections with inspection and test records.

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.default_evidence: Secure area rules and supervision or access records.

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.default_evidence: Policy, screen lock settings, spot check results.

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.default_evidence: Equipment placement plans, server room protections, environmental monitoring.

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.default_evidence: Off-site asset policy, device encryption, asset loan or travel records.

controls.title: Storage media
controls.default_evidence: Removable media policy, media register, encryption and disposal records.

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.default_evidence: UPS and generator maintenance and test records.

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.default_evidence: Cabling layout, protected cabling areas, patch panel access controls.

controls.title: Equipment maintenance
controls.default_evidence: Maintenance schedules and service records.

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.default_evidence: Data sanitisation procedure, wipe or destruction certificates.

controls.title: User endpoint devices
controls.default_evidence: Endpoint policy, MDM/EDR enrolment, encryption and configuration baselines.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.default_evidence: Privileged account inventory, approval records, PAM settings, periodic reviews.

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.default_evidence: Access restrictions in key systems, role-based permission exports.

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.default_evidence: Repository access lists, branch protections, access reviews.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.default_evidence: MFA settings, login controls, lockout and session configuration.

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.default_evidence: Capacity monitoring reports and forecast records.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.default_evidence: Anti-malware/EDR deployment coverage, update status, detection reports.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.default_evidence: Vulnerability scan reports, patching SLAs, remediation records.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.default_evidence: Hardening baselines, configuration standards, drift or compliance reports.

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.default_evidence: Retention and deletion procedure with deletion logs or certificates.

controls.title: Data masking
controls.default_evidence: Masking or pseudonymisation rules and examples in use.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.default_evidence: DLP policies, rule configurations, alert handling samples.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.default_evidence: Backup policy, job success reports, restore test records.

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.default_evidence: Architecture showing redundancy and failover test records.

controls.title: Logging
controls.default_evidence: Log sources, retention settings, protected log storage evidence.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.default_evidence: Monitoring rules, alerts, SOC/SIEM review records.

controls.title: Clock synchronization
controls.default_evidence: NTP configuration on systems and log sources.

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.default_evidence: Restricted utility list, access controls and usage logs.

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.default_evidence: Software installation controls, approved software list, change records.

controls.title: Networks security
controls.default_evidence: Network diagrams, firewall rulesets, review records.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.default_evidence: Network service provider agreements and security requirements.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.default_evidence: Segmentation design, VLAN and firewall rules, test results.

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.default_evidence: Web filter policy, category settings, blocked-access reports.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.default_evidence: Cryptography policy, approved algorithms, key management records.

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.default_evidence: SDLC policy and evidence it is followed in projects.

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.default_evidence: Security requirements documented for applications, with sample traceability.

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.default_evidence: Architecture principles and design review records.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.default_evidence: Coding standards, code review evidence, SAST results.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.default_evidence: Test plans, penetration test reports, acceptance sign-offs.

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.default_evidence: Contracts, security requirements and oversight records for outsourced developers.

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.default_evidence: Environment diagrams and access separation evidence.

controls.title: Change management
controls.default_evidence: Change policy, change tickets with approvals, testing evidence.

controls.title: Test information
controls.default_evidence: Rules for test data use and evidence production data is protected or avoided.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.default_evidence: Audit testing agreements, scoped access, approval records.
